sloka: ऋषयो प्युग्रतपसो दैवेनाभिप्रपीडिताः ।उत्सृज्य नियमाम् स्तीव्रान् भ्रश्यन्ते काममन्युभिः ॥२-२२-२३॥
transliteration: ṛṣayo pyugratapaso daivenābhiprapīḍitāḥ ।utsṛjya niyamām stīvrān bhraśyante kāmamanyubhiḥ ॥2-22-23॥

translations.english: Even rishis with severe austerities are tormented by destiny and are swerved from their observances because of anger and passion.
